test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the person from the given statements.

He founded e-commerce giant Amazon in 1994 out of his garage in Seattle. He stepped down as CEO to become executive chairman in July 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jeff Bezos**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Amazon was founded by Jeff Bezos in 1994 as an internet bookseller.
 
• He founded e-commerce giant Amazon in 1994 out of his garage in Seattle. He stepped down as CEO to become executive chairman on July 5, 2021.
 
• Overview
 
 
• Bezos is the founder of Amazon, the world's biggest online retailer.
 
• The Seattle-based company sells electronics, household goods, and other products through its flagship website.
 
• It also controls the Whole Foods grocery chain and offers cloud computing and streaming services.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Amazon:

 
 
• Founded: 1994
 
• Founder: Jeff Bezos
 
• Headquarters: Washington

• President and CEO: Andy Jassy
 
 
 
• Amit Agarwal is the Country head of Amazon India.
